reviews.title: Perfect 4k gaming monitor
reviews.comment: 4k OLED with 240hz. Color saturation is great. Haven't had any issues so far. Great gaming monitor if your pc can push 4k at 240fps.
reviews.author: TechGearHead

reviews.title: Excellent monitor
reviews.comment: After calibrating, the display is beautiful with vibrant colors and deep blacks with no blooming. Text is nice and crisp. I don’t game but do a lot of RAW image and 4K video processing and it works great. The stand is sturdy and is readily adjustable. Refresh rate 120 Hz on my desktop, no issues. I am really happy with this monitor, more so in that I got it at an excellent sale price.
reviews.author: DaveS

reviews.title: Excellent, Well Rounded Monitor.
reviews.comment: This is a near excellent monitor. The quality of the stand and screen is excellent. The monitor looks great out of the box, with little configuration needed. The monitor does provide the advertised 240Hz refresh rate and resolution as advertised. If you are not getting the correct resolution and refresh rate, the issue is likely the cable you are using. This monitor performs well in light environments, and has a great anti-glare coating. Some people may find the screen to be too “matte” and would prefer a more glossy coating from another brand.
reviews.author: Dawson

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY!
reviews.comment:
I bought this monitor and it broke after 3-4 months.  The power/menu button in the back actually split in half!  I contacted Samsung and they said it was "physical damage" outside the warranty.  They invited me to pay to ship it to them and pay to have it repaired.  I refused and bought a similar monitor from another vendor.  I think this product is a scam where:
1. You pay Samsung ~ $1,000 for a monitor they KNOW has poor build quality
2.  The monitor breaks
3.  Samsung informs you the break is outside the warranty terms
4.  Samsung makes more money off of a repair
Don't fall for this scam!
reviews.author: Edward L. Roy

reviews.comment: Best monitor I have ever owned flat out period full stop.  Great for gaming and everything else.
